WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Written for the live game, levels 1 to 60, as of the November 12 hotfixes. Numbers are the client's, read with its hotfixes. The talent order is Icy Veins' published one, dated, and it replays legally on the current tree; Wowhead's levelling build is described from its own text. Rotation reasoning that cites WoWSims is a model's, and says so. The level 60 material was published before any raid opened, so none of it rests on a raid log. Where a spell's tooltip disagrees with the text here, trust the text: tooltips can lag behind a hotfix.

What Arcane is for

Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. 3/3 keeps 50% of your regeneration running through every cast, and Mage ArmorMage ArmorLevel 34 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost270 ManaDuration1800 secIncreases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec. at 34 adds its own 50%. Icy Veins and Wowhead both count the two as full regeneration while casting. That is what pays for Arcane BlastArcane BlastLevel 20 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 5Cast1.5 sec castCost15% of base ManaRange30 yd rangeBlasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application., whose mana cost climbs +100% per cast.

Icy Veins rates it 4/5 for levelling, a score that measures solo kill speed; Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish no levelling score. Its heading is "A Solid Leveling Spec": "The Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. talent significantly reduces downtime between fights as it regenerates a lot of mana even during combat." Wowhead's levelling guide calls it "great for low-effort questing" and lists its costs: fewer tools than Frost in world PvP, and more damage taken, because enemies reach you more often.

In Classic, Arcane Power raid builds spent their damage casts on Frostbolt instead of the Arcane tree's own spells; ClassicWoW.gg puts it plainly: "Forever gives you Arcane Blast and Missile Barrage to build around Arcane-school damage itself."

In dungeons Icy Veins scores it 5/5 and names two drawbacks. Your burst can pull threat: "if the tank is not used to your burst or unable to handle large AOE pulls, you are likely to pull aggro." And you have no slow of your own until Cone of ColdCone of ColdLevel 26 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost210 ManaCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration6 secTargets in a cone in front of the caster take 96 to 106 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec. at 26.

Stat priority

Both sites that rank Arcane's stats do so for level 60, and both call their lists provisional.

  1. Hit, to 17% against a raid boss. Icy Veins gives 4% as the figure against a same-level target; PrecisionPrecisionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%. supplies up to 6%
  2. Spell Power, including Arcane damage
  3. Critical strike: Arcane MindArcane MindTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%. 5/5 doubles the crit bonus of Arcane spells
  4.
